title: Three Summers and One Short Tale
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：folk　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 folk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the collector ① recorded the folk that no scholar in the valley would have named, and he said the recording was the whole of the summer. The ② folk, meaning the people themselves and not the tale, ran three summers and stayed unnamed in the book; the folk, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ group of folk in that valley had the same short song beside it, and the ④ folk at the far bend, meaning the part they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. The folk, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the collector said the naming is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the folk was the whole of the matter, meaning the family and not the people. The ⑥ folk, meaning the family and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; folk, he said, is either something you record or the only word that means both the people and a family. He said the family is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ folk had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short song. The ⑧ folk of the whole thing, the collector wrote in August, was one valley and three summers of naming; folk, he said, is either the part at the far bend or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ folk I remember is the part named in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Folk, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being named; all folk, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like the people. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 人们；乡亲（指山谷里每一群旁边的那一群）
B. n. 人们（指那一群本身，与传说相对）
C. 固定搭配：record the folk 记录乡亲们
D. n. 乡亲（指留给孩子们的那一部分）
E. n. 人们（抽象总称，指一个山谷的记人之事）
F. n. 乡亲（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一部分）
G. n. 亲属；家人（folks，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人）
H. n. 家人（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人）

items.q: recorded the folk that no scholar in the valley would have named
The folk, meaning the people themselves and not the tale
Every group of folk in that valley
the folk at the far bend
the folk was the whole of the matter
the folk had become a line in a plan
The folk of the whole thing

answers.why: record the folk 意为“记录乡亲们”，1966 年那位采集者记下了山谷里没有一位学者肯说出名字的乡亲。
folk 意为“人们”，指那一群本身而不是传说，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
folk 意为“人们、乡亲”，指山谷里每一群旁边的那一群，每一群旁边都有同一支短短的歌。
folk 意为“乡亲”，指留给孩子们的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
folk 意为“亲属、家人”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人，叔叔说这家人就是那件事的全部。
folk 意为“家人”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人而不是那群乡亲，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的人。
folk 意为“乡亲”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一部分，到 1973 年这一群成了计划里的一行。
folk 意为“人们”，采集者八月写道，整件事的记人之事是一个山谷和三个夏天的说出名字。
folk 意为“乡亲”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一部分，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一部分。
folk 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，乡亲是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的人。
